name: Gwen X
source:
You decide to go meet your childhood best friend, Ben, before heading to college.

Ben worries that you are not ready for college life, so he decides to help you out with a secret from his cousin's stash!
translation:
你决定在上大学之前去见见你儿时最好的朋友本。

本担心你还没有为大学生活做好准备，所以他决定帮助你解开他表弟藏匿的秘密！
